input_fields.name: unsaved_change_disposition
input_fields.description: Explicit save, discard, or cancel disposition for unsaved changes; no default is inferred.

result_fields.name: closed_document_state
result_fields.description: Target identity, close action, final absence, and remaining-work state.

procedure: Confirm target identity and inspect whether unsaved changes require the supplied disposition.
Issue one close action for the target document; if a prompt appears, choose only the declared disposition.
Re-observe target absence and other open documents, then return closed_document_state.
If a prompt/identity is unexpected, stop and return blocked or needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous target, missing disposition, unexpected save prompt, or a request to close multiple documents.
Do not silently discard user work.
Do not reopen or verify geometry in this atom.
